### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: When discussing symptoms in the Assessment, only include those explicitly reported by the patient or directly attributed as symptoms by the doctor. Do not list objective findings (e.g., vital signs, physical exam results) as symptoms.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Ground all patient-reported habits, activities, admissions, and denials strictly to the transcript. Accurately reflect frequency and degree (e.g., 'rarely exercises' is not 'denies exercise'). Do not convert admissions to denials (e.g., 'occasional alcohol use' is not 'denies alcohol use'). Avoid inferring information or denials for topics not explicitly discussed.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: When reporting objective findings (e.g., vital signs, physical exam results), only include qualitative descriptors (e.g., 'normal', 'elevated', 'low') if they are explicitly stated by the doctor in the transcript. Otherwise, report the raw measurement without interpretation.
